title: 第13章 蜃楼现世启传送远行第14章智降守兽拜见守关人
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 地窖外，天色渐渐暗了下来。
城头的喊杀声终于停了，取而代之的是一种更令人不安的沉默。
苏余知道，不是城守住了，是妖兽暂时退去。
它们没有离开，只是在重新集结，等待下一次冲击。
就在这时，他识海中的时王碑忽然剧烈震动。
一股庞大到令人窒息的灵力波动从黑风岭方向传来，穿透了地窖的黄土墙，穿透了他的血肉骨骼，直接轰入识海。
苏余猛地睁开眼——尽管他身处地下，头顶是数尺厚的夯土，但他仍然“看见”了外面的天空。
黑风岭上空，一座巨大的宫殿虚影正在缓缓浮现。
那是一座青铜色的巨大建筑群，悬于云端之上，飞檐翘角，雕梁画栋，每一块砖瓦都散发着古老而威严的光芒。
它的轮廓半虚半实，像是隔着一层水波在看一座水底的宫殿。
假遗迹的海市蜃楼，终于现世了。
苏余深吸一口气，双手结印按在胸口——那是苏玄传承中记载的引动法印。
识海中时王碑轰鸣，暗金色的碑身亮起一道道血管般的脉络。
他感觉到自己的体温在急剧攀升，全身血液像是被点燃了一样沸腾起来。
制造投影需要一炷香。
而他只有一次机会。
他闭上眼睛，将全部心神沉入识海。
在地窖的地面上，一圈暗金色的光芒正在缓缓亮起。
光芒勾勒出一个复杂到极点的符文阵图，阵图中心是一个古朴的“时”字篆文——与他手背上的纹路一模一样。
金色纹路如经络般从阵图中心向外蔓延，一寸一寸地吞噬着地窖的黑暗。
与此同时，黑水城的城墙上，所有人都看到了那座悬于天际的青铜宫殿。
铁把头忘记了还在流血的伤口，仰头看着天空，嘴唇哆嗦着说不出话。
西区的铁甲统领把手里的刀拄在地上，刀尖刺入城砖，她浑然不觉。
那些活过了兽潮第一波冲击的散修们，此刻全部呆呆地站在城墙上，望着那座只在古老传说中出现过的遗迹。
“上古仙府……上古仙府现世了！”有人跪了下来，泪流满面，“天佑我黑水城！”
城墙一角，林霜负剑而立。
她看着那座青铜宫殿，又低头看了一眼守宫蛊所在的胸口位置——蛊虫正在微微震颤，不是朝拜，是警惕。
它在警告她，那座宫殿里有一股极其古老、极其强大的力量。
而在黑风岭外围，无数道人影正在朝山脉深处赶来。
有踩着飞剑的修士，有骑着妖兽的强者，还有在密林中快速穿行的散修。
他们来自各个方向——青云宗、铁剑门、灵蛇商会、黑虎帮，还有数不清的无名散修。
所有人的目光都盯着那座悬于天际的宫殿，每个人的心里都燃着一团火。
content_en:
Outside the cellar, the sky gradually darkened.
The shouts of killing at the top of the city finally stopped, replaced by an even more disturbing silence.
Su Yu knew that it was not that the city was defended, but that the monsters had temporarily retreated.
They didn't leave, they were just regrouping, waiting for the next impact.
At this moment, the Shiwang Monument in his consciousness suddenly shook violently.
A huge and suffocating spiritual power wave came from the direction of Black Wind Ridge, penetrated the loess wall of the cellar, penetrated his flesh and blood bones, and blasted directly into the sea of ​​consciousness.
Su Yu opened his eyes suddenly - even though he was underground with several feet of rammed earth above his head, he still "saw" the sky outside.
Over the Black Wind Ridge, the shadow of a huge palace is slowly emerging.
It was a huge bronze-colored building complex, suspended above the clouds, with cornices and carved beams, and every brick and tile exuded an ancient and majestic light.
Its outline is half virtual and half solid, as if looking at an underwater palace through a layer of water waves.
The mirage of fake ruins finally appeared.
Su Yu took a deep breath and pressed his hands on his chest - it was the inducing seal recorded in Su Xuan's inheritance.
In the sea of ​​consciousness, the King's Monument roared, and the dark golden body of the monument lit up with veins like blood vessels.
He felt that his body temperature was rising rapidly, and the blood in his body was boiling as if it had been ignited.
Creating a projection requires a stick of incense.
And he only had one chance.
He closed his eyes and sank all his mind into the sea of ​​consciousness.
On the floor of the cellar, a circle of dark golden light was slowly lighting up.
The light outlined an extremely complex rune pattern. In the center of the pattern was a simple seal script with the word "Shi" - exactly the same as the pattern on the back of his hand.
Golden lines spread outward from the center of the array like meridians, swallowing up the darkness of the cellar inch by inch.
At the same time, everyone on the city wall of Blackwater City saw the bronze palace hanging in the sky.
Tiebaotou forgot about the still bleeding wound and looked up at the sky, his lips trembling and unable to speak.
The armored commander of the West District put the knife in his hand on the ground, and the tip of the knife pierced the city bricks, but she didn't notice it.
Those casual cultivators who had survived the first wave of the beast tide were all standing blankly on the city wall, looking at the ruins that had only appeared in ancient legends.
"The Ancient Immortal Mansion... The Ancient Immortal Mansion has appeared!" Someone knelt down with tears streaming down their face, "God bless me, Blackwater City!"
At a corner of the city wall, Lin Shuang stood with his sword in his hand.
She looked at the bronze palace, and then looked down at the chest where the palace guard Gu was - the Gu was trembling slightly, not in worship, but on guard.
It was warning her that there was an extremely ancient and extremely powerful force in that palace.
On the outskirts of Black Wind Ridge, countless figures were rushing towards the depths of the mountains.
There are monks riding flying swords, strong men riding monster beasts, and casual cultivators traveling quickly through the dense forest.
They come from all directions - Qingyun Sect, Iron Sword Sect, Spirit Snake Chamber of Commerce, Black Tiger Gang, and countless nameless casual cultivators.
Everyone's eyes were fixed on the palace hanging in the sky, and everyone's heart was burning with fire.
